name: workflow
description: Coordinator routing, branch task planning, minimal-code implementation, indexed field guidance, final review acceptance, and Fallow-backed simplification audits.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinator routing, branch task planning, minimal code, field guide, review cycle, and simplification review.
interface.longDescription: Route work through Planning, Investigation, and authorized Implementation. Create external branch task ledgers through branch-task-planner. Use minimal-code for the smallest correct change. Consult indexed field guidance and record committed review corrections. Use review-cycle for final acceptance. Use simplification-review directly or for material minimality, reuse, ownership, complexity, or cleanup risk.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow:coordinator to route planning, investigation, and authorized implementation.
Use $workflow:branch-task-planner to interactively create or modify an external branch task ledger.
Use $workflow:minimal-code as the default implementation lens for small, readable, low-ceremony changes.
Use $workflow:field-guide to consult project guidance or record committed review-derived learning.
Use $workflow:review-cycle after meaningful edits as the final diff-and-evidence acceptance gate.
Use $workflow:simplification-review for standalone or risk-based, read-only simplification audits.
